source: IHSE draco tera compact manual (480 series)

notes: One-slot upgrade board for the CPU unit side of any draco vario / ultra extender (474, 481, 483, 490-495): analog audio and RS-232. It travels over the extender's own link, so it sits in the slot next to its extender module. Draws up to 300 mA at 5 V.

name: draco SIRA CPU module (Cat X 1G)
source: IHSE draco SIRA CPU datasheet
notes: Thin client and KVM transmitter in one draco vario module: it opens remote sessions (RDP, RemoteFX, SSH, VNC, HTML5 kiosk) over its network port and sends them into the draco matrix or to a CON unit over its link port. USB 2.0 and 2-channel audio are embedded. Draws 3.0-3.5 A at 5 V from the chassis, so it needs a ventilated chassis (one with a backplane such as 474-BODY6BPF, or a 474-MODFAN fan). 129 x 40 x 145 mm, 300 g. Invoice part number L488-BIPC-R1 is revision 1 of L488-BIPC. Check: slot count (assumed one slot like the other vario modules).
